headline: Argentine sovereign debt falls as CCL dollar surges 12%
summary: Global risk aversion hit Argentine assets hard as sovereign bonds fell, the CCL parallel dollar climbed 12% over three sessions, and country risk spiked.
why: Argentina's financial markets are highly sensitive to foreign exchange liquidity and debt refinancing risks.

impacts.name: Argentine Sovereign Bonds
impacts.why: Market doubts over upcoming debt payments prompted bond liquidations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Inflows to dollar-denominated assets and upcoming debt maturities pressured domestic asset values.
